items.text: Make My Perfume is an independent fragrance studio for people who find meaning in the small rituals.

We make fragrance in small batches, in India, with a belief that luxury should feel personal rather than precious. Each composition is built in layers: a bright first thought, a textured middle, and a base that stays close.
Our bottles are designed to live on your shelf. Our formulas are vegan. Our approach is slow enough to notice the details.
